title: Jobs-oriented investment and stability: identification-feasibility assessment
primary_question: Can existing source-governed FCV data support credible inference on jobs-oriented investments and violence/stability, and if not which measurement/identification bottleneck dominates?
scientific_target: J versus genuinely unexposed N as the primary intended contrast; O versus N and J versus O retained as complementary mechanisms and negative-comparison context, not substitutes.
scientific_boundary: W8 J/O/N are sector-composition proxies, not validated jobs, wages, or employment effects.
W8 country-period standardized levels are not causal ATT/DiD estimates.
Prior-biennium VAC is not guaranteed pretreatment for J/O with earlier recorded investment.
N is source-bounded to covered China/WB projects and observed history, not guaranteed no investments.
Original ADM3 matched-pair/trio deliverable remains distinct from W8 ADM2 descriptive standardization.
No external communication, outcomes fits, data recoding, task dispatch or estimator promotion authorized by this planning graph.

w8_reference_checks.warning: These are W8 reported descriptive values, not this graph's findings.

tasks.name: Freeze evidence and define target decisions
tasks.deliverable: Source-locked W5–W8 receipt index, original Eric ADM3 pairs/trios requirements, explicit estimands/decision thresholds, risk register
tasks.acceptance: Distinguishes sector proxy from validated jobs labels; tracks N purity and left censoring; no historical result reclassified as causal.

tasks.name: Treatment and employment-mechanism audit
tasks.deliverable: Outcome-blind, versioned bounded sample of project records; explicit job-objective versus plausible indirect jobs versus unclassified; project lifecycle/timing data inventory
tasks.acceptance: Audit sample and sampling frame frozen in advance; evidence references and unknowns retained; no unreviewed project upgraded to verified job creation; stop at bounded pilot.

tasks.name: J–N selection and counterfactual feasibility
tasks.deliverable: Support/overlap and placement diagnostic; first-observed exposure cohorts; previously treated history; prior-outcome trajectory availability; feasible and infeasible identification assumptions
tasks.acceptance: Reports full and effective independent support, selection covariates available before exposure, multi-period prehistory where identifiable, and a go/no-go for any DiD; matching does not claim to solve unmeasured placement.

tasks.name: Spatial exposure and control contamination
tasks.deliverable: ADM2/ADM3 geometry and geocode uncertainty card; local versus neighboring project exposure and N contamination diagnostic; available commuting/mobility proxies
tasks.acceptance: States what location data actually identify, sensitivity to uncertain geometry, spillover/interference assumptions; no automatic ADM3 upgrade or buffer hunting.

tasks.name: Outcome alignment and observability
tasks.deliverable: Theory-to-outcome map (ACLED/UCDP violence categories; Afrobarometer stability/attitudes where available); chronology/coverage/zero semantics; precision and minimally meaningful effect assessment
tasks.acceptance: Small predeclared outcome family; timing and availability audited; separate synthetic detector capability from real substantive inference; no outcome selected by p-value.

tasks.name: Cross-diagnostic candidate designs and stopping rules
tasks.deliverable: Rank at most two bounded designs: one primary J–N strategy and one complementary mechanism/measurement strategy, with evidence requirements and reasons to stop
tasks.acceptance: Each design states estimand, treated/control population, exposure clock, assumptions, falsification, inference unit and precision target; unsupported designs marked infeasible.

tasks.name: Independent review and Director decision memo
tasks.deliverable: Independent review plus ≤3-page decision memo: PROCEED_SPECIFIED_DESIGN / IMPROVE_MEASUREMENT_FIRST / DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY_OR_STOP
tasks.acceptance: Separates measurement, selection, power, spatial interference, and identification; explains possible credible null; Director chooses before any new empirical execution.

decision_gate.ready_when: F00–F06 evidence and review present; no promotion on status words alone
decision_gate.next_action: Manual pull by Director after other Scientific Council business

privacy: No row-level outcome/project records committed to Git. Project-level protected source evidence stays in governed external source storage.
